pages.rationale: Both frames (2 and 2b) are reproduced region for region: grouping bar, scope chips, 4-up family grid with exemplar/medoid overlays, per-card footer strip, legend line, and the full right rail down to 'edges z-norm Euclid - cut 0.42 - a7f3...9c'. All 7 manifest states reach their expected selectors with zero console errors; the groupings popover, unit Seg, filter chips, omitted drawer (10/page, pager 1-10 of 38), sequence composition strip and every rail action fire a real navigation or a 'not wired yet' toast. Deductions are visual only: the shared mV domain is drawn as +/-0.7 where every frame and the family page say +/-0.4, the default sort is 'family id' not the frame's 'members in scope', the rail caption truncates to 'members - sha...', the sequences rail's 'needs multi-seed' hint is clipped by the viewport edge, and ?scope=<channels> is ignored.

findings.title: Card mV axis is +/-0.7, frame says +/-0.4
findings.detail: Every atlas card labels its y axis +0.7 / mV / -0.7 and the F-03 rail hero the same; frames 2 and 2b label all of them +0.4 / -0.4, and the family page (frame 3) does use +/-0.4 with the caption 'shared mV scale - +/-0.4 mV - 21 s'. The widened domain flattens the low-amplitude families badly: F-07 slow drift (+/-0.08 mV) renders as an almost straight line where the frame shows a readable rising S-curve. The two Library pages now disagree about the same 'shared mV scale'.

findings.title: Default sort is 'family id', frame shows 'members in scope'
findings.detail: The sort control reads 'sort: family id'; frame 2 reads 'sort: members in scope'. The dropdown does offer members in scope / judged fraction / duration / hand edits, so only the default differs.

findings.title: Rail caption truncated to 'members - sha...'
findings.detail: The members-overlay caption renders 'members - sha... 10 of 44 sampled'; the frame shows the full 'members - shared y - mV'. The 'edges' row also wraps onto two lines where the frame keeps it on one.

findings.title: 'needs multi-seed' hint clipped by the viewport edge
findings.detail: In the S-02 rail the disabled 'Seed search in Discovery' reason renders as 'needs multi-see' with the last characters cut off at x=1440; frame 2b fits the whole phrase inside the rail.

findings.title: ?scope=<channels> deep link ignored; Browse drops the scope
findings.detail: #/library/atlas?scope=M2_aug_fs1:CH1_A1 renders the default 3-channel scope chips (CH3_A2, CH4_A2, M3_jul CH2) unchanged, and 'Browse 3 channels ->' on recurrence navigates to #/library/atlas with no ?scope= at all. The inventory specifies 'Browse -> #/library/atlas?scope=<sel>'. ?scope=all does work.

pages.rationale: Frame 3 is reproduced closely: unjudged banner with the 'a proposal, not a finding' line and 'Send 68 to Review as a queue', exemplar/medoid hero at +/-0.4 mV over 0-21 s, the 8 summary KV pairs, the sampled-members overlay with resample, the sort Seg + hand-edits-only toggle + select-page + pager, 10 member cards carrying d, channel, hours-since-start and verdict dot, the 'Removed by hand - 1' restore strip, the batch bar, and the full member rail with context strip, provenance callout, revisions, verdict, tags, class and the three footer actions. All 10 manifest states resolve, including both confirm modals, the tag validation error, the S-02 placeholder and the F-99 missing-family state; no console errors. Deductions are copy-level only.

findings.title: Class select shows '2 - burst' instead of 'burst'
findings.detail: With 3 members selected the m-1850 rail's class select reads '2 - burst'; the frame reads just 'burst', and the same control on m-1844 (1 selected) reads '- none'. A leading count in a single member's class field is misleading - it reads like a class code.

findings.title: onset - duration reads 196.6 h - 21.6 s, frame says 196.6 h - 1.62 s
findings.detail: The rail's duration for m-1850 is 21.6 s; frame 3 shows 1.62 s. (21.6 s is internally consistent with the family's '21 s +/- 4', so the frame may be the wrong one - worth a deliberate decision rather than a silent divergence.)

findings.title: Rail rows wrap where the frame keeps them on one line
findings.detail: 'added to F-03 - this installation - 14 Sep  Undo' wraps to three lines and 'rev 1 machine d-88402 - rev 2 edited' to two; in the frame each is a single line. Cosmetic density difference in an otherwise faithful rail.

pages.rationale: Frame 1 is reproduced almost cell for cell: the matrix card with the per-hour/count Seg and recordings pager, three recording groups with tri-state checkboxes, coverage bars, exemplar sparkline row labels in family colour, the exact fixture values including the two red '! 0.61' artifact cells and the '?' no-coverage cells, 2 px selection outlines running header-to-last-row, the 5-swatch legend, the reading-rule caption, the 12-thumbnail omitted strip and the full right rail with the shared-ground callout. All 7 manifest states resolve with no console errors; cell click, cell title tooltip, row-label link, Deselect, Clear, Show all 38 and the toasts all work, and the held-out M4_aug block on page 2 is a proper locked card. Deducted for the ?sel= deep link being dead in both directions and for the selection never being written to the URL, plus the collapsed '+10 ch' columns having no expander.

findings.title: ?sel= deep link is ignored entirely
findings.detail: #/library/recurrence?sel=M2_aug_fs1:CH1_A1 and #/library/recurrence?sel= (empty) both render the default 3-channel selection - rail still reads 'M2_aug fs1 CH3_A2, CH4_A2 - M3_jul CH2 - members 412'. The inventory names ?sel= as the deep link for the selected state and ?sel= as the route to no-selection. The empty state is only reachable by clicking Clear, so the smoke manifest never catches it.

findings.title: Selection changes are never written to the URL
findings.detail: Ticking a channel checkbox or clicking a cell updates the rail totals correctly but leaves the hash at #/library/recurrence. The inventory says the channel checkbox 'writes ?sel= (replace, no history)', which is what would make a selection shareable and what would make the ?sel= deep link above meaningful.

findings.title: '+10 ch' / '+4 ch' collapsed columns have no expander
findings.detail: Recording captions read '721 h - 31% reviewed - +10 ch' and '280 h - 18% reviewed - +4 ch', but the suffix is plain text - there is no control to expand the hidden channels in place. The inventory's recommendation for the 16-channel fog is a collapsed '+10 channels, no members' column that expands in place. Declared as fog by the builder, so this is a known gap rather than an oversight.

findings.title: Rail 'reviewed' reads 30 %, frame says 26 %
findings.detail: The Selection block shows 'reviewed 30 %'; frame 1 shows '26 %'. (The 'hours 128.4 h' -> 'channel-hours 1,722 h' change is the inventory's own recommended reconciliation and is not counted here.)

pages.rationale: Frame 4 is reproduced faithfully and then extended well: the four numbered sections, the 3-up unit cards with counts 1,402 / 350 / 16, the distance / feature-bins / labels column headings with sequence-similarity correctly disabled under single motifs, the frequency-content panel with feature select, quantiles/log-spaced/fixed-edges Seg, bins and range, the log-axis histogram with amber 'outside range' bars, both 'what does not fit' checkboxes with their live counts, and the Preview strip with the purple hand-edits line and the grey 'applying regroups the whole catalogue' line. All 9 manifest states work, and the ones the frames never drew are handled better than required: invalid shows an inline '2 to 20 bins' message, blanks the preview and disables both footer buttons; applying disables every control and shows 'job l-0031 - 2/4 bin - 38 % - Cancel job'; failed shows 'failed at write grouping' with Retry; over-limit swaps Apply for 'Create SLURM script' with an explanatory line; saved toasts 'Saved g-09 - not applied'. One visual deduction.

findings.title: No dimming scrim behind the modal
findings.detail: The modal renders over a fully bright, full-colour atlas (family cards, rail traces and the scope chips are all at normal contrast). Frame 4 dims the whole page behind the modal to flat grey blocks, which is what makes the dialog read as modal; the inventory describes the state as 'modal over dimmed atlas'. Same on the recurrence and family variants.
